turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Would you mind by starting with what brought you in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so over the last week I've just been feeling some symptoms. It kind of first started with, like a runny nose. That was around like 5 days ago and then it turned into just a lot of congestion, like around my nose and like my throat. And now over the last two days I've been just feeling so much pressure around my nose and around my jaw so I've been getting a lot of pain there as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is your nose still running?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I'm still getting some discharge and I also feel like I'm getting some dripping at the back of my throat too, especially when I wake up.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and could you describe the discharge? Is it clear, yellow, greenish?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's fairly clear and sometimes, like a bit white, but like, it's not like green or yellow.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and have you felt that it's difficult to breathe in through either of your nostrils, like it's obstructed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so at night sometimes I have to like turn because one side of my nose gets difficult to breathe from and then it kind of balances out on the other side. So yeah, I do have some obstruction.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any changes to your sense of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so just in the last three days when the congestion got really bad I started losing the ability to smell.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any changes to your sense of taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, taste is fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any cough or sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. No cough or sore throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and the symptoms have gone on for five days. Have you had a period of time where you got better and then got sick again?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did kind of have a runny nose last week as well, so probably like 8 days ago but then the runny nose discontinued a little bit but really got worse 5 days ago, but all these other symptoms just happened in the last few days.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you have pain. Do you feel it in your jaw or do you feel it in the in the front of your nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I would say mainly over the cheeks. It can kind of go near the front of my teeth as well, so like I would say like mostly around the cheeks, jaws and up to the front of my teeth.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, And do you grind your teeth at all at night? or have you had, TMJ issues before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No nothing like that. I think it's not so much on and around my teeth, it's more so just to right below my nose, above my teeth and just around my cheeks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so no pain in your mouth or anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not inside my mouth.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I Don't think I've had a fever. I did feel some chills over the last few days, but just very brief episodes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and over the last few weeks have you had any weight loss?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you said you didn't have a cough or a sore throat, but have you had any wheezing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No wheezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How about any shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not shortness of breath. Just sometimes when my nose gets like really congested, I just turn into like a mouth breather, but that's about it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK, and have you had any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and any lightheadedness or feeling dizzy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sorry, what was that?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had any diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No diarrhea.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And have you had any rashes or skin changes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, then how about any muscle aches or joint aches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any muscle weakness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And how has your energy been? Any fatigue?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, it's been mainly OK, just maybe sometimes difficult to get to sleep with all the all the congestion, but I don't think my energy has been affected too much, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and, uh, sorry to go back to this, I don't think I asked. Did you notice any discharge from your eyes or any eye redness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Not discharge, but yeah, maybe a little bit of redness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have your eyes been itchy?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm Yeah, a little bit. I would say they have been a bit itchy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright then, do you have any medical conditions that you see a physician for regularly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, just uhm, its called dyslipidemia.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see, and any medications you take for that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just like a Statin medication.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you take any other medications? over the counter? prescribed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, other than that I take multivitamins.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you have any allergies to medications or like environmental allergies that might be getting worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not that I know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you don't experience any symptoms like this when the seasons change?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't think so. I have had this happen to me, Uh, I would say like once before. It happened like two years ago. It was pretty similar.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and what was done at that time?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: At that time it kind of just went away on it's own. It got better. I feel it's definitely worse this time. But at that time I didn't even go to the doctor, it kind of just went away.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. Any recent hospitalizations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No hospitalizations.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and could you tell me where abouts you're living currently and who you're living with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I'm currently living in an apartment by myself, just outside of London.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and anybody that you've been around who's had any symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so no sick Contacts. And have you traveled anywhere out of the city or province?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've tried to stay home, besides going to work. I just work at the grocery store. Besides that, no, nowhere else.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any of your coworkers have any symptoms? Or any coworkers being off sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, we're pretty careful right now with the pandemic.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, yeah, that's great. OK, and do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I quit just a couple of years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh, that's great. It's not easy to quit, so that's awesome. And do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just maybe like red wine a couple of times a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see, OK, and do you use any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, just, in a month, maybe once or twice, I smoke a joint.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and anybody in the family have any lung or heart conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, and how about any cancer in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, no cancers.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I think I that was everything I wanted to ask about today. Was there any other symptoms or anything else that you wanted to make sure I knew about today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No,  I think that's all. I just didn't know if I needed any, like, medications or if I needed to get tested. I just wanted to make sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, so well, certainly check your temperature to see if you have a fever. And if you do and it's high enough, that will increase the chance that you have a bacterial sinusitis,  and if so, with some of your symptoms, including the discharge, obstruction, loss of smell, and facial pain, that all fits the picture for it and also you had a period where you felt a little bit better and then worse again. So that might require antibiotics, but we will check your temperature and go from there.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Alright, sounds good, thank you so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Thank you.
